architecture_source: environment/nanogpt_substrate.json, replicated here because tests/Dockerfile assembles the verifier image from tests/ alone and a checker that reached into environment/ at grading time would be grading against bytes the agent surface also carries
read_back_from: /logs/harness/feed.json budget and tokens_fed, and /logs/harness/model.json parameter_shapes, both written by tests/runner.py inside the verifier's own process from the corpus it fed and the decoder it built.
why_it_is_load_bearing: Before this row the graded path only ever compared tokens_fed against whatever budget the pool bytes happened to declare, so the value was self-referential and the environment was not load-bearing for it. This carrier is generated from solution/grounding.yaml and is verifier-side, so the gate depends on the numbers themselves: a feed ledger graded against any other budget scores zero, a parameter snapshot whose shape is not the frozen architecture scores zero, and the bound evaluation point is budget exhaustion measured against the frozen figure rather than against a drifting one.
